meta.title: Mobile Vendor Bidding: refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Mobile app Mobile Vendor Bidding flow and its refusal or availability
Signing in as a user without the Vendor role and repeating the action as a Vendor
Verifying the tenant's Enterprise plan and RBAC configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Mobile app Mobile Vendor Bidding flow and its refusal or availability; Signing in as a user without the Vendor role and repeating the action as a Vendor; Verifying the tenant's Enterprise plan and RBAC configuration

steps.note: Create a published RFQ that can be used for the bidding attempt.
Configure the event as an RFQ pricing stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add one product so the bid sheet has a line item.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite a QA vendor so a vendor-side bid can be attempted.
Publish the event needed for bidding.
Confirm the event is live before handing off the mobile role checks.

args.need: sign in to the Enterprise tenant's mobile app as a user without the Vendor role, attempt Mobile Vendor Bidding and record the refusal or absence, then repeat in the same tenant as a Vendor and record whether the action is available

steps.note: The mobile app and alternate-role sign-ins are not available in the catalog.
Confirm the session remains free of an application error after the tester's mobile-role checks.
